title: Remediation Canvas: keep partial work actionable
audience: Developers grouping related quality findings who need human intent and source drift visible in the handoff.
promise: Reference authoritative findings, state a human remediation intent, preserve dispositions, and mark the canvas stale when the source set changes.
story: Three Quality Lens finding references enter one canvas without copying their payloads.
A human marks one finding resolved, one blocked, and leaves one unresolved with a next action.
A source change replaces one finding and changes the fingerprint.
Refresh reports stale while preserving the original partial handoff for review.
verified_locally: Stable Quality Lens references and human intent/dispositions captured in a local canvas.
Changed finding set produces a stale refresh without erasing partial work.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass.
Current dev fresh and stale refresh flows were rerun headlessly.
1600×900 PNG/SVG preview was regenerated and visually reviewed.
open_gates: Complete one verification receipt and prove source-authority parity with Quality Lens.
Connect the handoff to the downstream review surface without copying findings.
Connect the local case to a hosted no-auth URL and verify it.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a local W3 partial/stale handoff; it does not claim automatic remediation, source-tool integration, hosting, or publication.
